project.title: Standardised Corporate Tax Filing Workflow Rollout
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardised workflow for corporate tax filings to reduce errors, rework and late submissions across all client accounts.
deliverables: End-to-end tax filing process map and RACI
Standardised tax return preparation checklist and templates
Centralised tax deadlines and obligations calendar
Tax documentation and evidence retention guideline
Quality review and sign-off procedure for tax returns
Training and onboarding pack for tax filing workflow
constraints: All changes must comply with current tax legislation and bookkeeping regulations
Initial workflow must be ready before the next monthly filing cycle
Solution must work using existing office and spreadsheet software
Client data confidentiality and access controls must be preserved
Documentation must be simple enough for new staff to follow
No additional headcount or external consultants allowed

risks.risk: New workflow is not fully adopted by all tax clerks, leading to inconsistent practices.
risks.mitigation: Run short training sessions, collect feedback, and mandate use of standard checklists for all new filings.

risks.risk: Process changes introduce delays during the first filing cycle.
risks.mitigation: Pilot with a subset of clients, monitor turnaround times, and adjust steps that add low-value overhead.

risks.risk: Updated workflow misses a specific tax obligation or deadline for some client types.
risks.mitigation: Cross-check process and calendar against tax legislation and have internal audit perform a sample review.

risks.risk: Improper handling of confidential client data in shared templates and archives.
risks.mitigation: Define clear access rules, store files in restricted folders, and include confidentiality rules in guidelines.

risks.risk: Lack of clear ownership for review and sign-off causes last-minute confusion.
risks.mitigation: Define RACI matrix with named roles and enforce sign-off steps in the checklist before submission.

themes.why_relevant: Workflow must reflect current tax rules and be easy to update when legislation changes.
Standard checks help catch inconsistencies, misstatements and potential fraud before filing.
Proper records support audits, disputes and future tax planning for clients.
Coordinated planning reduces overtime and risk of late submissions in peak periods.
Client financial data must be protected while still being accessible for review and audit.
Consistent processes make onboarding easier and improve quality across the team.

backlog.task: Map current end-to-end tax filing process for main client segments
definition_of_done: Process steps documented from data collection to submission
Variations by client type clearly noted
Pain points and common errors highlighted
Reviewed and agreed by at least two tax clerks

backlog.task: Design standard tax return preparation checklist
definition_of_done: Checklist covers data collection, calculations and review steps
Includes fraud and inconsistency red-flag checks
Aligned with bookkeeping regulations and tax legislation
Pilot used on at least three recent filings and refined

backlog.task: Create centralised tax deadlines and obligations calendar
definition_of_done: All recurring filing deadlines entered in shared calendar
Calendar segmented by client type and tax authority
Reminder rules set for preparation, review and submission
Validated by a senior tax clerk for completeness

backlog.task: Draft documentation and evidence retention guideline
definition_of_done: Retention periods defined per document type
Storage locations and naming conventions specified
Confidentiality and access rules documented
Reviewed by internal audit or equivalent function

backlog.task: Define quality review and sign-off procedure for tax returns
definition_of_done: RACI matrix created for preparation, review and approval
Thresholds for second-level review defined
Sign-off steps integrated into the checklist
Procedure approved by tax compliance manager role

backlog.task: Set up shared folder structure for tax workflow artifacts
definition_of_done: Folder hierarchy created for each filing year and client group
Access permissions configured according to guidelines
Template files stored in a dedicated templates folder
Short how-to note shared with all tax clerks

backlog.task: Compile training and onboarding pack for new workflow
definition_of_done: Slides or short doc summarising new process created
Links to checklist, calendar and guidelines included
One-page quick reference sheet prepared
Pack reviewed by at least one tax clerk

backlog.task: Identify and document top 10 recurring tax filing errors
definition_of_done: Recent filings sampled and errors catalogued
Root causes and impacted client types noted
Mitigation actions mapped to checklist items
Summary shared in channel for team awareness

backlog.task: Define procedure for handling tax authority queries and disputes
definition_of_done: Standard steps for receiving, logging and responding documented
Escalation rules and response timelines defined
Template response letters or emails drafted
Procedure aligned with confidentiality requirements

backlog.task: Schedule and coordinate pilot run of new workflow on selected clients
definition_of_done: Pilot client list agreed with tax clerks
Timeline aligned with upcoming filing dates
Calendar invites sent for key review checkpoints
Feedback collection method defined and communicated

backlog.task: Create simple control sheet to track filings status per client
definition_of_done: Spreadsheet lists all active clients and filing obligations
Status fields for preparation, review and submission added
Ownership and due dates captured
Tested with at least one full filing cycle for a subset of clients

backlog.task: Document process for updating workflow when tax rules change
definition_of_done: Trigger events for review of workflow defined
Steps for updating templates and guidelines documented
Communication plan for changes outlined
Approved by tax compliance manager role or equivalent

artifacts.title: Standard Tax Filing Workflow and RACI
artifacts.used_for: Reference for the agreed end-to-end process and role responsibilities.

artifacts.title: Tax Return Preparation and Review Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Operational checklist used for each tax return to ensure all steps are completed.

artifacts.title: Tax Deadlines and Obligations Calendar
artifacts.used_for: Shared calendar and table of all filing deadlines and obligations by client type.

artifacts.title: Tax Documentation and Retention Policy
artifacts.used_for: Guidance on what documents to keep, where to store them and for how long.

artifacts.title: Quality Review and Sign-off Procedure
artifacts.used_for: Defines review levels, sign-off steps and escalation rules for tax returns.

artifacts.title: Tax Filing Status Control Sheet
artifacts.used_for: Tracks preparation, review and submission status for each client filing.

artifacts.title: Top Recurring Tax Filing Errors and Mitigations
artifacts.used_for: Awareness and training material to reduce common errors in future filings.

artifacts.title: Handling Tax Authority Queries and Disputes
artifacts.used_for: Step-by-step procedure and templates for responding to tax authority queries.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, key deliverables and roles for the tax workflow project.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and asking for confirmation on scope and responsibilities.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the final list of project deliverables and which roles own each one.
Agree on the filing cycles and client segments included in the first rollout.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and iterate on the tax return preparation checklist and review steps.
threads_plan.trigger: Tax clerk shares first draft of the checklist and asks for comments and additions.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the structure and mandatory items of the tax return checklist.
Decide how fraud red-flag checks are integrated into the checklist.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Set up and validate the deadlines calendar and filing status control sheet.
threads_plan.trigger: Secretary posts initial version of the calendar and control sheet for validation.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm which deadlines and client types must be tracked in the shared calendar.
Agree on minimum fields required in the filing status control sheet.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Close on documentation, retention and query handling guidelines.
threads_plan.trigger: Tax clerk shares draft guidelines and asks for feedback from the team.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the documentation retention periods and storage rules.
Approve the standard procedure for handling tax authority queries.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and debrief the pilot run of the new workflow on selected clients.
threads_plan.trigger: Secretary proposes pilot client list and timeline before the next filing cycle.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the final list of pilot clients and confirm pilot timeline.
Agree on how feedback from the pilot will be collected and acted on.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async check-in where each participant posts what they did, next steps and blockers for the tax workflow project.
Weekly review message summarising status of key tasks and upcoming filing deadlines.
Post-pilot debrief thread capturing what worked, what did not and proposed adjustments to the workflow.
Ad-hoc mini sign-off posts when major artifacts like checklists or guidelines are ready for approval.
